summary: Prepared a fixed, authenticated Admin recovery for the three sales whose line costs are supported by sale-time product fingerprints. Preview is no-store and digest-bound; apply requires backup_restore, a same-origin exact body, rate/body gates and a fresh backup, then restores four lines and allocations for sales 16951-16953 in one guarded D1 batch with a durable receipt, non-reversible history and redacted provenance audit. Sale 16951 alone deducts stock and records a sale movement because it is completed; awaiting sales 16952-16953 receive released allocations without stock effects. Sale 16952 keeps its later USD 2.70 fee/actual-cost edits and repairs only item-derived subtotal/total. Sale 16954 is reported as blocked because current product cost matches its pre-sale lot cost but the product row was updated after the sale, so sale-time product cost is not proven.

changes: Added migration 0145 with one fixed-incident durable receipt, three fixed-sale receipt members and a transient atomic guard; registered durable receipt tables in backup/restore and reset ordering.

Added saleIncidentRecovery helper with exact target/snapshot/cost/lot/effect fingerprints, digest-bound preview, one D1 batch, strict stock subtraction, released awaiting allocations, receipt reconciliation, postcondition verification and explicit unknown optional price fields.

Added authenticated no-store preview and backup-first same-origin apply routes with backup_restore permission, rate and body-size limits, post-commit cache/broadcast refresh and fixed response contracts.

Added focused real-Hono migrated-SQLite coverage for permission, preview contract, exact apply/replay, stale state, lost response, rollback, backup failure, origin/body/rate gates, sale 16952 preservation and explicit null pricing metadata.
Added a read-only evidence compiler, preview contract validator, current production evidence summary, offline manifest and explicitly read-only pre/post SQL review queries.

risks: The v1 helper intentionally fails closed if any sale, revision, product, stock or unique-positive-lot fingerprint changes before apply; a new reviewed manifest/code update would then be required.
Recovery-time lot attribution is recorded explicitly and is not represented as proof of the originally intended lot.
Sale 16954 remains itemless until a pre-sale product-cost source is found and a separate v2 recovery is reviewed.
Independent security/data-integrity review and full release gates are still required before migration 0145 or the Worker route can be deployed.
